_comment: WORKER KEYS USB = KEYS ONLY. No users.json or service config — see provision.backend.json. Carries only join/mesh/CA keys + break-glass ssh/root.authorized_keys; gets all config + secrets from the pki node (ArgoCD + Vault/ESO).
_comment_mesh: Leave endpoint empty to default tailscale login_server to the pki node's LAN IP (works before public DNS). cp_dns_name is the stable control-plane name the kubeadm join targets over the mesh.
_comment_kubernetes: Worker join. api_server left empty auto-targets cp_dns_name:6443 over the mesh. token + ca_cert_hash come from the first control-plane's `kubeadm token create --print-join-command`.
_comment_nodes: Reach the pki control-plane + mesh by IP (written to /etc/hosts), so tailscale login_server (-> pki node) and the kubeadm cp_dns_name target resolve before MagicDNS/public DNS exists.
